description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy values associated with different data augmentation techniques applied to a BERT model. The horizontal axis displays the augmentation method, labeled “1st layer” through “unperturbed”, in a sequential order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy”, represents a linear scale ranging from 70 to 95, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Each augmentation method is represented by a single, teal-colored bar, with the exception of the last four methods, which are represented by red-colored bars. The shortest bars correspond to “random +R₂” and “random +permute”, both reaching approximately 82 on the accuracy scale, while the tallest bar, representing “unperturbed”, reaches approximately 93. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
